description: Visual-only jar meshes and label texture of the approved T14 'Open a jam jar' scene (scene-expansion trajectory_r1 build.py: a revolved continuous glass profile and a cylindrical printed label with an original generic 'STRAWBERRY JAM' texture rendered from DejaVu fonts). Copied byte for byte, except the exporter's URL comment line removed from the .obj/.mtl headers (PROTOCOL §2.7: no upstream address in agent-readable files); no physics depends on them.
license: Original procedural assets of the scene-expansion T14 build (trimesh revolve + PIL text, DejaVu fonts under the Bitstream Vera/DejaVu license); no third-party branded mesh.
